crop.notes: Column of 'Tips. At Home and Abroad' sporting notes; only the fifth item (one sentence) is about Tom Allen. Allen item complete; last item about Paddy Ryan runs off the bottom.

ocr.notes: Allen item mostly readable but 'not a fighter in' garbled to 'nota ae'; other items have many errors

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat noted in a brief sporting item that Tom Allen said there was not a fighter in England among the would-be champions who would take £50 or £100 and fight him for it.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, December 5, 1880, page 6

facts.fact: Allen, then in England, said no would-be champion in England would take £50 or £100 to fight him

notes: Statement is reported indirectly, not a verbatim quote. Allen was living in England at this time (1877-1882).
